seo.title: Thank you: service enquiry received
seo.description: Your enquiry about a Calwebtech service has reached the people who deliver it. Here is what happens next.

title: Thanks. Your enquiry is with us.
intro: Your question has gone to the people who deliver this service, together with the page you sent it from. A confirmation email is on its way to the address you gave.

steps.title: We read it with the service in mind
steps.body: The person who replies works on this kind of project, so you will not be passed around.

steps.title: We reply within one business day
steps.body: You get a straight answer by email, or a time for a short call if that is quicker.

steps.title: We suggest a next step
steps.body: That might be an answer, a call or a proposal. If the service is not right for you, we will say so.

secondary.heading: While you wait
secondary.body: Our price bands are published, so you can check the likely range for your project now.

image.alt: A project team planning a website with sticky notes on a whiteboard
